authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6507.2 *dekṣati gives the dekh- “see” family, including Hindi dekhna and Rajasthani dekhṇo, and explicitly discusses its spread across Indo-Aryan. Survey dekh/dekho imperatives and dekhyo past forms are ordinary inflections of that stem; no light verb is present. The comparative family link retains uncertainty about transfer between Indo-Aryan languages.
